creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/modal-stone/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_ancient_god/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 and NumPy 2.5.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python). The output parent directory must exist.
patch: PCG64 seed 4807 for voices; reverb impulses are seeded noise (PCG64 seeds 101 and 202). Low open-fifth drone: five-partial additive sine voice, detuned twin (x1.0034), 1.6 s swell, 0.11 Hz breathing, seeded phase offsets and dust. Stone percussion: four inharmonic modal stones (ratios 1, 2.32, 3.87, 5.61 with separate decays), a falling low thud and a seeded grit click, panned. Reverb: 2.6 s seeded-noise impulse per channel applied by circular FFT convolution, wet 0.42, so tails cross the loop boundary. Events and releases wrap modulo the loop. Master gain 1.2, nearest-even PCM16 quantization without dither.
tuning: C pentatonic set (C D F G A), tonal center C, A4 = 440 Hz; drone C2+G2 (then G2+D3) open fifth, sub C1 in the transition
register_note: Measured mono energy share: below 100 Hz -0.8 dB, 100-450 Hz -8.0 dB, 450-1600 Hz -25.1 dB, 1.6-5 kHz -41.4 dB, above 5 kHz -47.0 dB of total. The bronze warning register (450-1600 Hz) is nearly empty of bed energy, leaving it open for sfx_tell_boss and sfx_counter.

boss_transition.note: Cue points, not extra loops. Bar numbers are 1-based; frames are sample frames per channel at 60 BPM (44,100 frames per beat, 176,400 per bar).
boss_transition.description: Bar 13 holds one faint flint where the displaced pulse should fall; bars 14 and 15 carry no stone and the drone gains a C1 sub; the keystone lands on beat one of bar 16; the pulse re-enters at bar 17 with a lone slab on beat 2.5.

loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: Bar 17's drone phrase and the reverberant tails of the last bars are still sounding across the final frame and continue into bar 1; frame 0 equals the continuation of frame 3527999.

verification.rebuild: Two independent render processes wrote to separate empty directories (together with the eight SFX). Master WAV, all SFX WAV and provenance bytes matched (diff -r).
verification.meter: FFmpeg 8.1.2 ebur128 (peak=true) on the master WAV; not the pinned 6.1.1 build, which this machine lacks. Re-measure on the pinned build in the packing step.
